method: Read the short input and decide whether the label is supported by the text; results facts are the model's own accepted output, so a result label can only be judged plausible, not cross-checked against an independent state diff.

shortInputs.label: act
shortInputs.note: Character sheet + pending tasks; the act/skip decision depends on the round's action text, which the short input omits.

shortInputs.label: achieved
shortInputs.note: Negotiation action with no roll; achieved is consistent with the accepted fact but not independently checkable here.

shortInputs.label: blocked
shortInputs.note: Stopping a lock clasp can fail; blocked is consistent.

shortInputs.label: no_change
shortInputs.note: Explaining an injury changes nothing observable.

shortInputs.note: Stop a bench? partial is hard to justify from this text alone.

shortInputs.label: partial

shortInputs.note: Checking whether gloves are needed need not achieve anything.
